{{Top|leg}}
An '''upper spine beamer''' was a piece of [[Ssi-ruu]]vi technology that could numb a body for up to two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and thirty-five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. The Ssi-ruuk installed an upper spine beamer to a special [[entechment]] bed that they had built to take advantage of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] capture.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
